original_evidence.related_evidence_limit: Neither related receipt directly observes the current EX1 raw packet and packed alias for both lane1 source alternatives.

hypotheses.primary: Current lane1 fixed-latency ALU and local-memory completion inputs preserve one full ProducerId and semantic payload through the common EX1 registered packet, exact alias extraction, ROB-open authorization, same-edge claim fence, and fail-closed death edges.
competing: The common EX1 packet preserves lane1 ALU identity but truncates or selects the wrong identity for the local-memory input.
A generation or raw-index field is truncated or mis-sliced while historical low-index observations still pass.
The packed alias is correct only because it feeds back from a corrupted field boundary rather than independently matching a stimulus-owned ProducerId.
EX1 same-edge arbitration compares only ROB index and incorrectly suppresses a generation-separated producer.
A flush masks the registered holder on the following cycle but leaves same-cycle completion authority live.

experiment.highest_information_gain: Compile current selected RTL and one focused TB for PRODUCER_GEN_W=1 and 4; derive generation=1 lane0/lane1 ProducerIds from the stimulus schedule; observe the ALU and lane1 local-memory EX1 input selection, raw registered packet, packed alias, result/destination/exception payload, exact authorization, same-index wrong-generation arbitration, one-cycle death, and flush cut; then require compile-success release-mode semantic variants to fail at one declared oracle stage.
observations: EX1 ALU up/down valid and full ProducerId
EX1 local-memory up/down valid and full ProducerId
EX1 result, destination, exception, cause and tval fields
same-cycle flush suppression and next-cycle stage death
experiment.expected_difference: Production baselines pass. Each semantic variant compiles successfully and is rejected only by its declared focused oracle stage.
experiment.stop_condition: Stop before any production RTL edit if current baselines and all variants close the two verification units; reclassify to production RTL fix immediately if a current baseline exposes a real RTL mismatch.

lower_cost_alternatives: Reuse V8F/V11M/V11Q receipts without a current EX1 packet test; rejected because those receipts do not prove common-packet field boundaries and mutation sensitivity for both lane1 source alternatives.
